solid-cbp.h264: 320x180 Annex B, Constrained Baseline, one slice per picture, no B-frames,
SPS/PPS repeated on every key frame (pictures 0 and 10), 20 pictures, VUI tags BT.601 limited range.

Generated with ffmpeg (libx264):

  ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=red:s=320x180:r=10:d=0.5 -f lavfi -i color=c=lime:s=320x180:r=10:d=0.5 \
         -f lavfi -i color=c=blue:s=320x180:r=10:d=0.5 -f lavfi -i color=c=white:s=320x180:r=10:d=0.5 \
         -filter_complex "[0][1][2][3]concat=n=4:v=1:a=0,format=yuv420p" \
         -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -bf 0 -g 10 \
         -x264-params repeat-headers=1:keyint=10:scenecut=0:sliced-threads=0:threads=1:colorprim=smpte170m:transfer=smpte170m:colormatrix=smpte170m:fullrange=off \
         -pix_fmt yuv420p -f h264 solid-cbp.h264

Pictures 0-4 red, 5-9 green, 10-14 blue, 15-19 white. Centre pixel (160, 90) of each picture
after `ffmpeg -f h264 -i solid-cbp.h264 -f rawvideo -pix_fmt bgra`, as (R, G, B):

  pictures  0- 4: (253,   0,   0)
  pictures  5- 9: (  0, 254,   0)
  pictures 10-14: (  0,   0, 254)
  pictures 15-19: (255, 255, 255)
